notes.title: Introducing The Escapists 2: Pocket Breakout!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/35b8b23ebe039c41d4cacb02a83742dc532590e0.png[/img]
Hey everyone

A lot of you have been asking for [b]The Escapists 2[/b] on mobile devices and today we’re super excited to confirm that it is indeed coming. It’s called [b]The Escapists 2: Pocket Breakout[/b] and [b]will be available on iOS, Android and Amazon phones and tablets[/b]. You won’t even have to wait long, as [b]it is launching in just two weeks on January 31st[/b]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nM0Sh1APiqs
[h1]So what’s The Escapists 2: Pocket Breakout?[/h1]
At its core, it’s The Escapists 2 you know and love. We will, however, be rolling it out slightly differently, with additional content being added over time.

At launch, you’ll get 5 prisons to escape from:
[b]Precinct 17[/b] (the tutorial)
[b]Center Perks 2.0
Rattlesnake Springs
K.A.P.O.W Camp
Area 17[/b]

The five remaining base game prisons will all be added over time completely free of charge, giving you a continuous reason to dive back in. We’ll have more details about additional content roll-out in the weeks and months to come.

The Escapists 2: Pocket Breakout launches with drop-in/drop-out local multiplayer allowing you to play with fellow escapists each on their own mobile or tablet device. This allows you to very easily jump between solo-play and co-op any time you want!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/5ebac6de8aa3f29ffad756c5e2e407adbc5eb979.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wallpapers[/h1]
If you’d like to show off your love for The Escapists 2, we’ve created some free wallpapers for several mobile and tablet devices, that you can download [url=https://www.team17.com/introducing-the-escapists-2-pocket-breakout/escapists/]right here[/url]. 

[h1]Be ready for January 31st[/h1]
If you want to be ready for January 31st, we’ve made pre-registrations (or pre-orders) available on [url=https://itunes.apple.com/gb/app/escapists-2-pocket-breakout/id1356167732]iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.team17.escapists2&hl=en_GB]Android[/url]. This will notify you when the game is available, and – if you have automatic downloads enabled – will automatically download the game at launch, so you can start your escape as quickly as possible.

Whether you’ve already played The Escapists 2 on Steam or consoles, or have been waiting for the mobile version, we hope you’ll enjoy The Escapists 2: Pocket Breakout!

See you on the inside.

notes.title: The Escapists 2 Reveal Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6173437/a3a6617662f31904e2942d08269a75deeec7715c.png[/img]

[b]PRISONERS![/b]
 
I want to start with a quick thank you to the amazing community that has made The Escapists the success it is. You tunnelled with us through Early Access, busted out of some of the world’s toughest prisons, and even fought off the dead in [url= http://store.steampowered.com/app/388060/]The Escapists: The Walking Dead[/url].
 
[b]And now it’s my pleasure to introduce you to the future of The Escapists…[/b]
 
[h1]The Escapists 2![/h1]
The first thing that you’ll notice when looking at The Escapists 2 are the visuals. Prison has never looked so good, and the new art style extends to a deeper variety of character customisation. When you look that good, it’s only natural to want to show it off, and now you can…
 
For the first time in Escapists history, you can team up with up to 3 other players in both co-op and competitive modes. Your escape team far away? Fear not Prisoner as the Escapist 2 will feature local [i]and[/i] online, drop in/drop out multiplayer!
 
We’ll have a ton of news about the game going forward, but in the meantime why not watch the new trailer?
 
[url=https://youtu.be/NMTwhVPqr2k]The Escapists 2 Reveal Trailer[/url]
 
Now that you’ve watched the trailer, head over to the The Escapists forum to discuss your theories and begin assembling your escape team! 
 
[h1]But wait…there’s more![/h1]
 
We haven’t forgotten about The Escapists and all of you that are still playing the game. So stayed tuned for news on more updates!
 
[h1]ICYMI: The Escapists Banned Camp![/h1]

Dive into The Escapists right now to play the free ‘Banned Camp’ map for a brand new escaping experience!

To keep up with the latest The Escapists 2 news be sure to follow us on Twitter here: @Escapists_Game

notes.title: The Escapists: The Walking Dead is Coming!
notes.content:
[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CJUTcsNWwAAaF1M.jpg:large]

[h1]IT'S TIME TO ESCAPE THE WALKING DEAD[/h1]

PRISONERS, 

You've escaped from our best efforts to keep you locked up, [url=http://www.team17.com/the-escapists-alcatraz-out-now-on-pc-xbox-one/]you've broken free from America's most notorious prison[/url], you've even [url=http://www.team17.com/escape-team]built a tank[/url] to bust out of a military POW camp. You think you're hot stuff. But it's not over yet. Today, we unveiled [b]The Escapists The Walking Dead[/b] - a new game in The Escapists series developed by Team17 in partnership with [url=http://www.skybound.com]Skybound Entertainment[/url], creators of The Walking Dead comic book series.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXN9ivXHdAk
The Escapists The Walking Dead sees you wake up in Harrison Memorial Hospital as Rick Grimes. You'll escape the horror unfolding there using familiar methods - craft gear to create escape routes and construct weapons to defend yourself from the flesh-eating horde. You'll also need to learn some new tricks, including the use of ranged weapons for the first time in The Escapists!

Later, Rick will take charge of a band of survivors featuring many of the original [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Walking_Dead_(comic_book)]The Walking Dead comic book cast[/url]. He must secure the safety of the group by seeking out an escape route in each of the game's areas and manage several dangerous tasks to keep as many of the group alive as possible. The Escapists The Walking Dead faithfully matches the timeline of the comics and so, as you make progress in the game, you play through locations that mirror the progress of the band of survivors taken from the award winning comic's epic story.

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CJURD2cUYAAqffa.jpg:large]

The Escapists The Walking Dead is coming soon to PC and Xbox One. To keep up with all the latest news, follow [url=http://twitter.com/Escapists_Game]Zombie Jimmy Locke on Twitter[/url]. Be sure to check out InTheLittlewood's first playthrough of the Tutorial level too:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h0qUl4HrU1s

What's your number one zombie survival tip? The correct answer is duct tape.

[h1]PRISONERS,[/h1]

Let’s get stuck in, shall we?


[h1]The Escapists Prison Editor Beta (Steam Only):[/h1]

•	[b]Added the ability to update maps on Steam Workshop:[/b] 
This means that, if you’re making changes to an existing map, you’ll no longer need to create a new Workshop file.

IMPORTANT: Updating an existing prison will invalidate any existing player save data for that prison – be sure to warn your inmates!

•	[b]Added tagging to Prison Editor and Workshop:[/b] 
You’ll now be able to choose from a few tags that will help players find your prison in the Steam Workshop! You’ll be able to give players an indication of how difficult your prison is, the style of your prison and its development status (Complete – no more updates / Work In Progress – players should expect updates). 

There are also additional tags which will be set automatically depending on the settings that you apply to your prison during creation.

Please note: prisons with incorrect tags (eg: YouTuber prisons tagged as Real Prisons) may be removed by the moderators. Tag accurately!

•	[b]Added additional language support for the prison editor beta:[/b]
German, French, Spanish, Russian and Polish languages are now supported. To change the language in use, use the buttons on the game launcher.

•	[b]The “undo” function now works correctly when undoing object placements.[/b]


[h1]The Escapists Game:[/h1]

•	Fixed multiple bugs relating to prisoners being inappropriately sideways.

•	[b]A new visitor will now visit inmates at the visitation area.[/b]
•	[b]A new item has been added to the game.[/b] The “DoDo Donut” can be found as a rarely spawning item in item spawn locations. Using this item will replenish fatigue and make you “Rad”.

Enjoy!

MT17

notes.title: Let Me Take A #Cellfie!
notes.content:
[img=https://d262ilb51hltx0.cloudfront.net/fit/c/512/512/1*uCbKNmgFZMnk_MjNgkez0w.png]

[h1]PRISONERS:[/h1]

The humble selfie. It splits opinion wherever it’s mentioned. So popular that it [url=http://www.amazon.co.uk/UFCIT-Handheld-Monopod-Ajustable-Blackberry/dp/B00J53T9WS]has its own peripherals[/url], so annoying that there are [url=https://www.change.org/p/people-taking-selfies-stop-taking-selfies]petitions calling for them to be illegal[/url].

Good for you then that you’re already in prison.

At HMP Irongate, we’re big fans of the humble selfie. In fact, we love photography in general, which is absolutely the one and only reason why there are security camera on every wall we could find. But this isn’t enough. Prisoners still find ways to avoid being caught on camera, which is why we’re launching a new, crowdsourced CCTV operation: [url=https://twitter.com/search?q=%23cellfie&src=typd]#Cellfies[/url].

[img=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CAl84APUwAAVdwy.jpg]

The idea is simple. Use [url=http://store.steampowered.com/news/5047/]Steam’s screenshot[/url] or Xbox One’s screen capture features to capture the best and worst moments of your prison experience. Send them to our [url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]prisoner monitoring center[/url] [WARDEN’s NOTE: Remove this when the post goes out, call it “twitter account”, sounds nicer] here. Each week, we’ll reward one lucky #Cellfie taking con with a The Escapists Hoodie.

But don’t just spam us with your pictures — each week there’ll be a theme to conform to based on our intelligence needs [WARDEN’s NOTE: Remove this. Call it “current events”]. The Warden will pick out the #Cellfie that best fits this theme, so pay attention to the [url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]prisoner monitoring center[/url] to find out the theme for the current week.

[url=https://medium.com/@Team17/let-me-take-a-cellfie-a232397727b2]Full terms and conditions for the competition can be found here.[/url] 

Get to it cons.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/298630/

[h1]More Questions?[/h1]
Head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/]forums[/url], we'd love to chat!


Thank you for purchasing The Escapists. Welcome to our prisons. It's Make or Break time!

P.S - after you've played the game for a while, be sure to leave an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/reviews/]honest review[/url]! We'd love to get your feedback.

Love,

Chris D (Creator)
MT17 (Community Manager)
And everyone at Team17!

notes.title: UPDATE 8: Camp Epsilon - Steam Cloud Saving - Achievements
notes.content:
PRISONERS,

So. You think you're all "escapists" now. 

A new facility opens its doors today, and it's designed with scum like you in mind. Cons, welcome to Camp Epsilon:

[img=http://cloud-4.steamusercontent.com/ugc/529506867153090611/0BECF7B6D79392294945A726B7B19DB53CC72D20/]

Epsilon is an open invitation for tower guards to shoot you in the face the very second you take a wrong turn. Your cell has no privacy, made up of mesh fence and no ceiling. You will eat outside. You will exercise outside. You will sleep outside. All under the watchful eye of my ever vigilant staff.

This, prisoners, is your reward for so brazenly ignoring the rules that society sets you.


[h1]Update 8: New Content[/h1]

[list]
[*]Camp Epsilon: An open air prison as a special bonus for all The Escapists players - thank you for your continued support! Find it under the CUSTOM tab on the prison selection screen.
[*]Steam Cloud Saving has been added: Your saves will now be accessible wherever you take your Steam account. Existing saves should not be affected, but let us know if there are any issues.
[*]Steam Achievements are now fully implemented. Check the forums for full details.
[/list]

[h1]Update 8 - Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved the location of save game files to your local "Documents" library (usually C:/Users/YOURUSERNAME/Documents)
[*]Mailmen can now place letters ON desks, just like books
[*]The health of vent system "slats" is now saved
[*]Fixed overlapping text on job boards
[*]Fixed overlapping text in missions menu
[*]Fixed a bug causing NPCs to get stick after being pushed off gym equipment in the gym
[*]Stopped the canteen chairs from inserting themselves into prisoners
[*]Added question marks to some mission text?
[*]Comb Shivs will now be detected by contraband sensors
[*]Unassigned desks are now labelled correctly
[*]Fixed an issue with the Prison Takeover popup
[*]Recruiting a buddy whilst they are in bed will no longer result in an incorrect animation on their sprite
[*]Snipers will now cease fire during a successful prison takeover
[*]Sound effects for the unloading job will now obey user-defined volume settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused sleeping after midnight to skip a day
[*]Fixed a few walls in the Jungle Compound
[*]Starting a new prison immediately after escaping another will no longer result in a instant-win
[*]Added a cap on the number of inmates with favours
[/list]

That's everything cons. 

The Escapists 1.0 releases on Friday 13th February. Be sure to follow us on [url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]@Escapists_Game[/url] for a ton of launch day awesomeness.

Until then, I genuinely can't wait to hear your screams of frustration in the forums. Good luck with Camp Epsilon!

MT17

notes.title: UPDATE: HMP Irongate Opens Doors, Prisoners Despair
notes.content:
[img=http://cloud-4.steamusercontent.com/ugc/55500653955474458/0817D17222187053BB091DE3B5D7CF1CB9157A32/]

Right then Turkeys,

It’s update time. 

Today we’ve added what is, by far, the hardest challenge you’ve faced in The Escapists so far. This prison is such a beast that it was very specifically chosen to be the last during Early Access (more on that below). Welcome, cons, to HMP Irongate.

Irongate is the premier destination for the prime scum of the earth. Equipped with an impressive arsenal of anti-escapist defences, plotting to get out of here will be a severe challenge – and, trust me, the prison walls are only a minor obstacle. 

[img=http://cloud-2.steamusercontent.com/ugc/55500653955482240/D6BF17D371847689E60DF347331AA5ABD329FC3B/]

But fear not, you’ll have plenty of motivation to leave. The guards at HMP Irongate are the best of the best at hating on you, patrolling the prison with severe frowns and electrified batons which will down you at the slightest touch. You can put that glint in your eye away as well, the batons use fingerprint ID’s and won’t work for anyone other than the guard they belong to.

The guards aren’t your only challenge. Kiss goodbye to your army of cons waiting for your command. They [i]hate[/i] new fish with a passion, so it’s probably a good idea to work on your public image. But good luck to you on that front too, free time is a rare commodity in Her Majesty’s Prison.

I have a final tip for you, and you should heed it well. Learn where the cameras are. 

That’s enough of me spoiling what will surely become the focus of all your hatred over the next few weeks, I look forward to your caps locked rage-posts in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/]forums[/url] ;)

Elsewhere in today’s update:

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[list]
[*] New items and craftables! No spoilers here, get to tinkering cons.
[*] Russian and Polish language support added (WIP)
[*] Payphones are now implemented. If you’re stuck, call for help. 
[*] A new workout is available –chin ups. Fix those biceps con!
[*] Some minor graphical improvements
[/list]

[h1]Changes and Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Guard tower snipers will no longer shoot you whilst you’re carrying a hostage. 
[*] [i]Certain items[/i] can now be used to disable security cameras.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*] Fake fences should now work correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the player from being attacked whilst on top of furniture.
[*] X-ray vision has been removed from guards, they’ll no longer see or prompt you if you’re inside a cabinet.
[*] Solitary confinement has been added to the guard’s patrol route in Center Perks.
[*] Stopped a bug that caused weirdness when a player dropped off a roof.
[*] Fixed various bugs affecting the use of ropes when descending from a roof.

[/list]

I mentioned earlier that HMP Irongate is our final Early Access prison. With today’s update, the game is nearing content completion and we’re very close now to a full release. Make absolutely sure that you’re either following us on [url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]Twitter[/url] or you’ve joined The Escapists Game Group, there will be some [i]very special announcements and kick-ass competitions coming very soon[/i].

Good luck, turkeys. 

MT17 & Chris D

P.S: You’ve no doubt read the news about Jimmy Locke, who needs your help to break out of Center Perks. [url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]Join us on Twitter for more.[/url]

notes.title: The Mexican Escapists: UPDATE 6! New Prison! Localisation! Custom Dialogue! Tutorial!
notes.content:
[img=http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/55499013264693740/908829F322222045E44845E41332BE2C0C24BF6E/]

Prisoners,

It's the most wonderful time of the year. I get to go home, eat turkey and laugh at rubbish cracker jokes. You lot get transferred to the San Pancho detention facility. I'm sure you'll have a fantastic time there. 

Update 6 for The Escapists is packed with new stuff, and it's our Christmas present to you. Here's the lo-down, cons:

[h1]New![/h1]

[b]San Pancho Prison[/b]
San Pancho Prison has been added to the game. Your hardest challenge yet, the inmates are horrifically violent - even the guards don't dare enter. Good luck cons, you're going to need it.

[img=http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/55499013263665142/DEC278EEF8AE596B4AC428322AA5D326A916AA08/]

[b]Tutorial![/b]
You asked us for a tutorial, so we knocked you over the head with a flimsy shovel. Whilst you're dreaming, you'll learn the basics of the game - how to control your con, how to interact with the world around you and the basics of masterminding an escape. 

Be sure to visit sickbay when you wake up. Concussion is really, really bad for you.

[b]Localisation![/b]
It begins! Our first localisation update is in the game with German, Spanish and French languages. This is VERY much a work-in-progress and we've set up a dedicated "localisations" thread so that you can show us where the gaps are. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/0/626329821049750258/]Find that here.[/url]

Massive, massive appreciation for Sgt_Cuz for helping with the German. Huge, huge love to Gaunth for helping us with Spanish and our un-requenting love for AngeArtilleur for showing us how to French. Thanks guys <3

[b]Custom Dialogue![/b]
You can now edit the things that NPC's say. Head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/4/]Custom Speech Files board to learn more![/url]

We've worked with 2 of YouTubes most popular criminals to bring you some custom dialogue files to get started with. Check out Warden Sparrow's file [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/4/626329821048456214/]here[/url], or add a little Punchwood to your game with Paul Soares Jr's dialogue file [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/4/626329821123567695/]here[/url]

[b]New Workouts[/b]
You asked us to look at the "working out" situation, some of you don't like mashing Q&E, others like it. So, we've added new workouts that don't require button mashing to even the playing field!

Check out the punch bags, skipping ropes and speed bags in your facility's gym.


[h1]Want more?[/h1]

Head to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/]community forums[/url] to see the full change log including bug fixes and tweaks!


We hope you enjoy the update. From Chris, myself and everyone at Team17 - happy holidays, many presents, lots of food and don't do anything that [b]Jimmy Locke[/b] wouldn't do.

Love,

MT17 & ChrisD

P.S - If you liked this update, use the thumbs up button below to tell us. It helps us get The Escapists' noticed on all of Steam's best bits. <3

[url=http://twitter.com/escapists_game]Follow @Escapists_Game on twitter for competitions, real escapists and more![/url]

notes.title: The Great Escapists Update - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img=http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/52114521697519874/B16F4EB5E36A4F754AA5179A826ADD577BE94261/2048x1150.resizedimage]

[h1]Prisoners![/h1]
You’ve had it too easy.

This week’s update will take your prison experience and add copious amounts of hardship. Within you’ll find a new prison: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=324655901&fileuploadsuccess=1]Stalag Flucht[/url], an old Prisoner of War (POW) camp. Say goodbye to your HD TVs and your cosy relationships with the guards, this is a zero-tolerance hell-hole equipped with some shocking features; you are there to stay. 

Other tweaks have been made to the game’s difficulty across the board, too.

Guards are getting pretty tired of your hoarding antics. A complete prison sweep will now take place any time an escape attempt is discovered; air vents, underground tunnels and roofs will be cleared of any illegal items. Trowels are no longer weapons of mass destruction and plastic cutlery isn’t what it used to be. Leaping off the roof onto objects below is no longer an option. An educational campaign amongst the prison staff has left the guards much more able to recognise powdered up wall when they see it and, when they do, expect trouble. Oh, and if you’re in a fight, you can expect some heat from the guards – regardless of “who started it”.

It’s not all horrific. We’ve added in 2 new workout routines and lowered the fatigue drain for working out. Four more jobs are available to keep you out of trouble. You’ll find better stuff in other inmates’ desks. There are new jingles in the game and, perhaps one of the most requested features in the Early Access community has been added; multiple save slots.

To read more infomation and see the full changelog, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/]join us in the forums![/url]

MT17

[b]If you liked this update, please give it a thumbs up using the buttons just below this text. That helps us get The Escapists exposed on all of Steam's best bits- meaning we can lock more gamers up! <3[/b]

notes.title: The Escapists: Early Access is OUT NOW! Here's what to expect...
notes.content:
[img=http://escapistgame.com/images/pic4.gif]
[b]Please Thumbs Up this announcement at the bottom of the page - it helps us get more exposure for The Escapists on Steam's community hub and front page! You can also [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/0/35221584340763708/]discuss this announcement here.[/url][/b]

Prisoners!

Today is the day that we throw you in the slammer and flush the key down Warden Dean Hall's toilet. HURRAY! Here's the lo-down on what you can expect from the first Early Access build:

[b]The Escapists Early Access features:[/b]
[list]
[*]A prison that's custom built for the Early Access: [b]The Fhurst Peak Correctional Facility.[/b] 
[*]Three jobs to keep you occupied: Laundry, Workshop and the Metalshop
[*]9 playabale avatars
[*]Over 100 items, many of which you'll have to craft to use!
[*]Visitor NPCs
[*]Prison Warden
[*]Employment officer
[*]And, of course, several ways to escape!
[/list]

[b]Early Access Bug Reporting[/b]
This is an Early Access game, so you should expect to find bugs, problems, issues and general mishaps in the game. Should you do so, it's vital that you report them to us in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/1/]Report a Problem forum[/url] so that we can get them sorted out. Make sure you [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/1/35219681771073539/]follow the instructions[/url] on how to report a problem carefully!

[b]Giving us Feedback[/b]
Our other objective during Early Access is to make tweaks to the game based on how players play it. 

Here's a list of stuff we want you to feedback to us about:
[list]
[*]New items
[*]Crafting recipes
[*]Dialogue / NPC reactions
[*]Small aesthetical changes
[*]Character ideas
[/list]
We're not looking for the following at this stage of Early Access:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer ideas
[*]New game modes
[*]Huge, gamechanging features
[/list]
The Escapists Early Access build is currently in the English language only. We're really keen to get the game fully localised for the comfort of non-EN players, and we're working hard to make that happen as soon as possible. 

We expect that Early Access will last until the end of this year, with a full release launching in Early 2015. Please understand that this may change in line with developments during the Early Access - rest assured that we'll always keep you updated here.

Oh! One last, important thing:
[b]The Escapists is priced at £6.99 / €8.99 / $9.99 initially.[/b] This price will increase as we add more content to the game and we'll always try to give you notice in the forums before these increases happen. In short - the cheapest time to get involved with The Escapists is right now!

The Escapists will launch at around 5PM BST / 9AM PST Wednesday 20th August (today!). We can't wait to see your escape plans!

Love,

ChrisD and Mike_Team17

<3

notes.title: The Escapists Weekly Dev Update #3 - EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
[img=http://www.xboxer.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/the_escapists.jpg]

[i]Full discussion thread here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/0/35221031522537908/ [/i]
[b]Please Thumb Up this announcement at the bottom of the page, it helps us get The Escapists on Steam's front page![/b]

Hey peoples, big week on The Escapists front!

If you didn’t catch it on Tuesday, the game was featured on stage at gamescom as part of Microsofts indie lineup for Xbox One ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V4Yv-p0Bc20]see the announcement here[/url]). Team17 are doing a great job on the XBOX One port while I crack on with the PC build. Even if you have no interest in the console version, the general awareness and interest in The Escapists saw a gigantic jump after the announcement, and that’s great for the game overall.

Even more exciting news: we now have the release date for The Escapists Early Access here on Steam! It’ll be released next Wednesday, the 20th of August. I know you guys have been itching to play (thank you so much for your patience!), your first opportunity to do is just one week away! You guys here on the forum are hearing this first, press releases and such regarding this will go out tomorrow.


[h1]What’s new?[/h1]

So what have I been working on over the past week? The following;

Outfits - Guard outfits and overalls are now working as intended. While wearing any disguise, it has its benefits but it also has restrictions on it. One of these is that your heat slowly rises while wearing it, simulating the rise in suspicion

Warden - Now and then the prison warden will visit. He’ll stroll around a little reminding everyone he’s in charge.

Job Staff - Another NPC, the employment officer. He stands behind the job office desk preaching about the importance of prison work.

[h1]Questions answered[/h1]

Here’s my responses to a few popular questions regarding the PC version;

[i]How much can I customise my avatar?[/i]
Currently you select from one of the character presets, name him, and jump right in.

[i]When will the Linux / Mac versions be available?[/i]
Once the Windows build is finished I’ll get looking at the other ports

[i]Can you break out with other prisoners?[/i]
Not with them, but you can use other prisoners to take control of and escape the prison by downing all the guards.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update #2
notes.content:
Hey guys, here's last week's update which we just realised was never posted to the announcements. Sorry about that! Get stuck in, another update will be posted soon!

---

Things are coming together nicely for the Q3 Early Access launch. All the things we’re working on are getting closer to completion - we should have a release date announced within the next few weeks.

In the meantime, here’s some of what I’ve been working on lately (minus the boring stuff about bug fixing and such!). 

[h1]Early Access Prison[/h1]

As I mentioned last week, the final game will have six prisons in total, with Shankton State Pen (the one I originally planned for early access) being the third.

After some thought though, I decided Early Access players should get something fresh and unique that won’t be available in the finished game. So what I’ve been working on is a new prison specifically for early access players. 

The prison is close to completion and will showcase all and more of the features that you'e already seen in Shankton. It doesn’t have a name yet, so your ideas and suggestions would be welcome, please post them in the comments below - I’d love to see what you come up with

Image: http://i.imgur.com/jPZVCaZ.gif


[h1]Visitation[/h1]

Another feature that’s been discussed in the forums here has now made it’s way in to the game. Players can visit the visitation area, sit down and have one of many random visitors come see them! They will spit out random dialogue from a fairly large database which often comes up with some hilarious outcomes.

Work in progress video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pJ584z15Vdg

I’d love to get some dialogue created by the community in here too, post your ideas below. Focus on punchy, one line comments - that’ll help me optimise them for the game’s database!


[h1]Prison Names[/h1]

Last week I put out the call for you to suggest some names for the prisons that are being worked on for the final game. Here’s a few that I loved;

For the Mexican open prison: El Averno by yager!
For the jungle compound: Ravensdale Correctional Facility by baldurfb!

Keep these coming, you can post them in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298630/discussions/]last week’s update thread[/url]. Provides a good read, thanks for posting!

That’s everything from me this week! Thanks for getting involved in everything we’re doing in the community hub. 

ChrisD
